GenAiFunction.description: Runs a payment gateway operation on behalf of the customer. Use this action to charge a payment method, refund a prior transaction, check the status of a transaction, or list transactions with paging. Set the operation input to one of: charge, refund, status, or list-transactions-with-paging, and provide the fields that operation needs (for example amount and currency for a charge, or transactionId for a refund or status check). Errors are returned as data with an error message rather than failing the conversation.
